provenance.methodology_note: Every decoder is measured on the same Stim circuit, the same detector samples, the same DEM and the same observable scoring (ler.estimate_ler_circuit_level). Only the decoder varies between rows. Rows are validated by ler.assert_comparable before being written.
provenance.supersedes: The six pre-v0.7.0 artifacts (benchmark_results.json, benchmark_results_empirical.json, chart_competitor.png, chart_throughput.png, competitive_results.json, live_test_results.json), which mixed code-capacity and circuit-level measurements and were withdrawn.
caveats: Throughput figures are only meaningful on an otherwise-idle machine.
LER figures are subject to binomial error; at low p and low shot counts the confidence interval can exceed the difference between decoders. Check ci95_lo/ci95_hi per row.
